studies.title: CPU vs R head-to-head (GSS/WVS, standardized, p = 15,20,25)
studies.note: pystatistics CPU (fp64) re-measured fresh at 5.0.0; R mvnmle reference re-run live at p=15 both surveys re-confirms curation parity (WVS p=15 |dloglik| = 2.8e-4, rel ~6e-10; GSS p=15 |dloglik| = 16.7, rel ~1.4e-3, the moderately ill-conditioned regime). p=20/25 R reference carried from the frozen artifacts (R is version-independent). CPU matches R to fp64 round-off and runs ~90-320x faster.

studies.title: fp32 GPU no-silent-wrong gate proof (CUDA, authoritative)
studies.note: CARRIED FORWARD from the 4.6.13 Forge run (no Forge access this pass; fp32/fp64 kernels byte-unchanged across 4.6.x->5.0.0). R12/R13 true-classifier proof: for each problem the fp32 GPU fit and the fp64 reference are both re-scored under one fp64 evaluator: deficit = fp64-optimum minus fp32-fit-rescored-in-fp64 (the true optimization gap), sigma_rel_fro = covariance error, ref_gate/gpu_gate = the default accept/refuse decision. Everywhere gpu_gate accepts, the fp32 fit is at the fp32 floor; at the boundary gpu_gate refuses (fp32 accept-set subset of fp64) -- never the dangerous direction. The fresh MPS leg below reproduces this behavior.

studies.title: fp32 GPU gate proof (MPS, secondary)
studies.note: FRESH at 5.0.0 on MPS. Confirms the CUDA gate proof (MPS is second-class; CUDA is authoritative). Same true-classifier behavior: at kappa=1e6 the fp64 reference accepts while the fp32 GPU path refuses (SingularMatrixError) -- the safe-side subset direction; WVS fp32 error near machine-fp32 (rel_fro ~1e-4), GSS a few percent (~3-9%), all gates safe-side. Reproduces 4.6.13.
